tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Diaz
professor.text: Some historians believe that individuals such as political leaders or influential thinkers have a greater impact on historical progress than broader social and economic forces. Others argue that social and economic events are the primary drivers of historical change. In your opinion, which has a greater influence on shaping history: individual actions or broader social and economic forces? Why?

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: I believe individuals and their actions have a greater impact on shaping history. Leaders and influential thinkers can inspire movements, create significant changes, and leave a lasting legacy. Their decisions and actions often alter the course of events in profound ways.

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: In my opinion, broader social and economic events are more significant in shaping history. While individuals can influence events, it is the underlying conditions and trends that drive major changes. These forces affect large groups of people and create the context in which individuals operate.
